scope: Source-owned NEW/REPLACE recorder publication. Host filesystem faults are explicit models; DOS cases use real kernel file operations, synthetic owned media, source-built compiler and UART replay. The read-only handle and raced-in targets are deliberate fixtures. Ambiguous close and disk-full paths are modeled, not physical fault observations. No terminal Record UI, foreground taps, distinct code-bank publisher, current-binary BBS/audio, physical modem, power-loss or F01-F16 whole-application acceptance.
